scope: 400 distinct artist-authored candidate rig parts; 5 age-stage base rigs; 12 expressions and 40 motions. Every status is planned, no source mesh is implied.
productionRule: One rig-part inventory record must map to a genuinely authored mesh shape or unique texture/decal topology, not merely recoloring the same mesh. QA requires stable attachment, age/skin compatibility and real GPU playback.
